name: Food delivery in Nepal
summary: Food delivery in Nepal is served mainly by app-based platforms in Kathmandu Valley and a few other cities, with Foodmandu and Pathao Food among the best-known names.
observations: Activity is concentrated in urban areas, especially Kathmandu Valley
Platforms compete on restaurant selection, delivery time and promotions
Digital wallets such as eSewa and Khalti are commonly used for online payment

name: Ride-hailing in Nepal
summary: Ride-hailing in Nepal is offered by app-based services such as Pathao and Tootle, mainly in Kathmandu Valley.
observations: Motorbike rides are a major part of the market
Regulation of app-based transport has been debated in Nepal

name: Digital payments in Nepal
summary: Digital payments in Nepal are led by wallets such as eSewa and Khalti, alongside bank apps and QR payment networks like Fonepay.
observations: Wallets are widely used for bill payment, top-ups and online shopping
Nepal Rastra Bank licenses and regulates payment service providers
QR payments have become common in shops and restaurants

name: Telecom in Nepal
summary: Nepal's mobile market is led by Nepal Telecom (state-controlled) and Ncell (privately owned, Axiata-backed).
observations: Smaller operators and internet providers exist alongside the two main mobile operators
Telecom services are regulated by the Nepal Telecommunications Authority

name: Banking in Nepal
summary: Nepal's banking sector consists of commercial banks, development banks and finance companies regulated by the central bank, Nepal Rastra Bank.
observations: Many commercial banks are listed on the Nepal Stock Exchange
Mergers have reduced the number of banks in recent years
Mobile banking and wallet integration are growing

name: E-commerce in Nepal
summary: E-commerce in Nepal is led by marketplaces such as Daraz and Sastodeal, with many social-media sellers also active.
observations: Cash on delivery remains common
Delivery logistics outside major cities is a challenge

name: Hydropower in Nepal
summary: Nepal generates most of its electricity from hydropower, with the state-owned Nepal Electricity Authority and many independent power producers.
observations: Nepal's rivers give it large hydropower potential
Seasonal river flow affects dry-season supply
Electricity exports to India have been growing

name: Aviation in Nepal
summary: Nepal's aviation sector includes the flag carrier Nepal Airlines and private domestic carriers such as Buddha Air and Yeti Airlines.
observations: Mountain terrain makes domestic flights important for connectivity
Tourism demand strongly influences airline traffic

name: Internet service providers in Nepal
summary: Fixed broadband in Nepal is provided by private ISPs such as WorldLink and Vianet, alongside Nepal Telecom.
observations: Fibre-to-the-home has expanded in cities
Bundled TV and internet packages are common

name: Foodmandu
summary: Foodmandu is a Nepali online food ordering and delivery platform operating mainly in Kathmandu Valley and some other cities.
observations: Focused on urban customers, mainly Kathmandu Valley
Competes on restaurant selection and delivery speed

name: Pathao Nepal
summary: Pathao Nepal is the Nepali arm of the Bangladesh-founded Pathao app, offering ride-hailing, food delivery and parcel services.
observations: Combines several services (rides, food, parcels) in one app
Operates mainly in urban areas

name: eSewa
summary: eSewa is one of Nepal's earliest and best-known digital wallets, operated by F1Soft Group.
observations: Launched around 2009
Used for utility bills, top-ups and merchant payments

name: Khalti
summary: Khalti is a Nepali digital wallet and payment service used for bill payments, top-ups and online payments.
observations: Competes with other wallets on merchant coverage and offers
Integrates with online services and bank accounts

name: IME Pay
summary: IME Pay is a digital wallet from the IME Group, which also runs a remittance business.
observations: Linked to the IME Group's remittance network
Used for wallet payments and transfers

name: Fonepay
summary: Fonepay is a Nepali payment network known for interoperable QR payments between banks and wallets.
observations: Allows one QR code to accept payments from many banks and wallets
Widely visible in shops and restaurants

name: F1Soft Group
summary: F1Soft Group is a Nepali fintech and software company behind the eSewa wallet.
observations: Provides software and payment services to banks and financial institutions
Best known for eSewa

name: Daraz Nepal
summary: Daraz is an online marketplace operating in Nepal as part of the Alibaba Group.
observations: Sells a wide range of consumer products from many sellers
Runs large seasonal sales campaigns

name: Sastodeal
summary: Sastodeal is a Nepali e-commerce marketplace.
observations: Competes with Daraz in online retail
Focuses on the Nepali market

name: Nepal Telecom
summary: Nepal Telecom (Nepal Doorsanchar Company Limited) is the state-controlled telecom operator offering mobile, fixed-line and internet services.
observations: State-controlled operator with nationwide reach
Competes mainly with Ncell in mobile services

name: Ncell
summary: Ncell is Nepal's main private mobile operator, owned by Axiata.
observations: Largest private competitor to Nepal Telecom
Offers mobile voice, data and digital services

name: Nabil Bank
summary: Nabil Bank is a major Nepali commercial bank, reported as the first foreign joint-venture bank in Nepal (established in 1984).
observations: One of the longest-established private commercial banks in Nepal
Listed on the Nepal Stock Exchange

name: NIC Asia Bank
summary: NIC Asia Bank is a large Nepali commercial bank formed through mergers.
observations: Among the larger private commercial banks in Nepal
Listed on the Nepal Stock Exchange

name: Global IME Bank
summary: Global IME Bank is a large Nepali commercial bank formed through mergers.
observations: Has a wide branch network across Nepal
Listed on the Nepal Stock Exchange

name: Everest Bank
summary: Everest Bank is a Nepali commercial bank founded in the 1990s, with Punjab National Bank of India as an investor.
observations: Established private commercial bank
Listed on the Nepal Stock Exchange

name: Himalayan Bank
summary: Himalayan Bank is a Nepali commercial bank established in the early 1990s.
observations: One of the older private commercial banks
Listed on the Nepal Stock Exchange

name: Standard Chartered Bank Nepal
summary: Standard Chartered Bank Nepal is the Nepal operation of the international Standard Chartered group.
observations: Foreign-owned commercial bank with a long history in Nepal
Known for corporate and retail banking

name: Nepal Electricity Authority
summary: Nepal Electricity Authority is the state-owned utility responsible for electricity generation, transmission and distribution in Nepal.
observations: Buys power from independent producers and distributes it to consumers
Central to Nepal's energy and export plans

name: Upper Tamakoshi Hydropower
summary: Upper Tamakoshi Hydropower Limited operates the 456 MW Upper Tamakoshi project, one of Nepal's largest hydropower plants.
observations: Among the largest hydropower projects built in Nepal
Supplies electricity to the national grid

name: Buddha Air
summary: Buddha Air is a private Nepali airline focused on domestic and mountain flights.
observations: One of the largest private domestic carriers
Offers scenic mountain flights

name: Yeti Airlines
summary: Yeti Airlines is a private Nepali domestic airline, with Tara Air as a sister carrier.
observations: Serves domestic routes including mountain airports
Competes with Buddha Air on major routes

name: Nepal Airlines
summary: Nepal Airlines is the state-owned national flag carrier of Nepal, formerly Royal Nepal Airlines.
observations: Operates domestic and some international routes
State-owned airline

name: Chaudhary Group
summary: Chaudhary Group (CG) is a leading Nepali business conglomerate, best known for Wai Wai noodles, with interests in food, hospitality, finance and more.
observations: Diversified across many industries
Wai Wai is among its best-known brands

name: Dabur Nepal
summary: Dabur Nepal is the Nepal subsidiary of India's Dabur, making consumer goods such as juices and personal care products.
observations: Part of a regional consumer-goods group
Sells in the fast-moving consumer goods market

name: Unilever Nepal
summary: Unilever Nepal Limited is the Nepal subsidiary of Unilever, making home and personal care products.
observations: Part of a global consumer-goods group
Sells in the fast-moving consumer goods market

name: Surya Nepal
summary: Surya Nepal is a major Nepali manufacturer, known for tobacco products and a wider range of consumer goods, with ITC as a partner.
observations: Large manufacturer and taxpayer in Nepal
Diversified beyond tobacco

name: Nepal Oil Corporation
summary: Nepal Oil Corporation is the state-owned company that imports and distributes petroleum products in Nepal.
observations: Main importer of petrol, diesel and LPG
Fuel pricing is closely tied to government policy

name: Nepal Stock Exchange
summary: Nepal Stock Exchange (NEPSE) is Nepal's main securities exchange, where listed companies trade.
observations: Banks and hydropower companies form a large part of listings
Tracked through the NEPSE index

name: Bhat-Bhateni
summary: Bhat-Bhateni is a major Nepali supermarket and department-store chain.
observations: Operates large stores in major cities
Popular for groceries and household goods

name: WorldLink
summary: WorldLink Communications is one of Nepal's largest private internet service providers.
observations: Offers fibre broadband mainly in cities
Offers bundled internet and TV packages

name: Vianet
summary: Vianet Communications is a Nepali internet service provider.
observations: Offers fibre broadband in urban areas
Competes on speed and price

name: Kantipur Media Group
summary: Kantipur Media Group is a major Nepali media house publishing Kantipur and The Kathmandu Post.
observations: Operates newspapers, radio, TV and online news
Among the most widely read Nepali news brands

name: Himalayan Java
summary: Himalayan Java is a Nepali coffee-shop chain.
observations: Operates cafes in Kathmandu and other cities
Known for Nepali-grown coffee

name: Dish Home
summary: Dish Media Network (Dish Home) is a Nepali direct-to-home satellite TV provider.
observations: Offers satellite TV and related services
Also offers internet bundles
